appDesc.message: Automatically continues web AI chats using native continue controls or a language-aware custom prompt.

stopCommand.message: Stop AI Auto Continue in the active tab

localOnlyText.message: Local only. The extension does not upload conversations.

promotionDisclosure.message: Promotional link · opens only when clicked · no tracking parameters

promptAutoHint.message: The latest completed AI reply is detected once before the first prompt send. Browser-language fallback:

promptFixedHint.message: The selected language is used for this run:

promptCustomHint.message: Your custom prompt is used exactly as written.

customPromptRequired.message: Enter a custom prompt before starting.

localProcessingDisclosure.message: After you click Start, the extension reads the current AI reply and input state locally to decide when and what to send.

runConfirmationAuto.message: Click Start to authorize up to {count} automatic messages to {site}. The message will be a localized equivalent of “Continue with the next step.”

runConfirmationConfigured.message: Click Start to authorize up to {count} automatic messages to {site} using the continuation prompt shown above.

unsupportedSiteText.message: For safety, AI Auto Continue only runs on AI websites supported by this project.

safetyLine.message: Current tab only · pauses automatically when you type

activityWaiting.message: Waiting for the AI to finish…

popupError.message: Unable to communicate with the current tab.

settingsSubtitle.message: Configure the message and safety behavior used by the quick popup.

messageSettingsDescription.message: Choose how the extension creates the next message.

languageHelp.message: Automatic follows the latest completed AI reply, then falls back to the browser language.

continueCutOffHelp.message: Use the AI website’s own “Continue generating” control before sending a new message.

safetyLimits.message: Does not bypass usage limits, login, or verification

supportedSitesDescription.message: Only built-in, project-maintained adapters can run. Platform support remains Beta until live-site certification is complete.

interfaceDescription.message: Choose the language used by the popup and settings page.

interfaceLanguageHelp.message: The settings page reloads automatically after you change the interface language.

unsupported_page_mode.message: This page is not a supported AI chat. Open a normal conversation and try again.
